label: bare_result_should_query_false
source: hand-authored from real-CLI observations (SDK 0.3.280, haiku, 2026-09-22; logs run-K.log and siblings from the shouldQuery:false investigation): every shouldQuery:false message is answered by exactly one bare result like this, whether it is the boot handshake or a mid-session append, idle or busy. Field set as observed on the wire, minus fast_mode_disabled_reason, fast_mode_state and subagent_stats, whose values the probe did not log; no terminal_reason and no api_error_status. user_message_uuid/user_message_uuids echo the client uuid the host stamped on the message (placeholder here; tests override it with the pushed message's uuid). total_cost_usd is the session's running cumulative (0 on a fresh session, the restored total on a resume). Re-record or hand-update this file on every SDK bump.
